set.body: NiftiStagingCache currently keys compressed input by path/size/mtime and trusts any cached file >=352 bytes. Reproduce stale same-metadata sources and corrupted cache through public stage/open APIs. Repair with content identity, verified staged bytes and coordinated atomic publication; preserve source files. Add configurable expanded-byte/free-space limits and interruptible streaming so desktop can supply safe budgets without an app-local loader. Regression evidence including concurrency, corruption, cancellation and limits; dataset JVM and JS suites required. Consumer plsneuro bd-01M1VMCXJ9ZRHSA9B0FX60VEGP.
set.title: Verify staged NIfTI content and bound cancellable decompression
